name: Pinot's Palette Olathe Mahjong 101
description: Painting studio in Olathe running a Mahjong 101 beginner class. Own page: "Instruction covers tile identification, game setup, the Charleston exchange, reading the National Mah Jongg League card, basic strategies, and building winning hands." Reservations required; no future date confirmed on the page.
address: 11945 S. Strang Line Rd., Olathe, KS 66062
schedule: Public Mahjong 101 classes are scheduled periodically; reserve through the studio's Register for Class link. Earlier dates seen: Aug 30 and Apr 8/15 (2026).

name: Johnson County Parks & Recreation Mah Jongg Drop-in Groups
description: Five 50-plus drop-in Mah Jongg groups at Johnson County Park & Rec community centers. Suggested fee $1 per person. The county page does not say American or NMJL; KCUR (not the organizer) describes them as American/NMJL.
schedule: Tomahawk Ridge Community Center (11902 Lowell Ave, Overland Park) Thu 13:00-16:00; Meadowbrook Park Clubhouse (9101 Nall Ave, Prairie Village) Wed 13:00-16:00; New Century Fieldhouse (551 New Century Pkwy) Tue 13:00-16:00; Roeland Park Community Center (4850 Rosewood Dr) Thu 13:00-16:00; Mill Creek Activity Center (6518 Vista Ave, Shawnee) Tue 13:00-16:00 and Tue 17:15-19:15.

name: The Bam Bam Room KC
description: Dedicated mahjong parlor in Leawood opened September 2025 with open play, leagues and lessons. Its own site does not say American/NMJL; the Martin City Telegraph says the venue focuses on the Americanized version.
schedule: Own site lists Open Play ($8), Day League Play ($135), Night League Play ($135) and Mahjong 101 + 102 beginner lessons ($120). Press article: open Wed-Sat 10:00-17:00 with some evening events; 24 seats. Event dates not found.

name: Congregation B'nai Jehudah Sisterhood Mah Jongg
description: Sisterhood Mah Jongg evenings and an annual community tournament at The Temple in Overland Park. The event listings do not say American or NMJL.
schedule: Sisterhood Mah Jongg dates listed: Nov 18, Dec 2, Dec 9 2026, Jan 6, Jan 20, Feb 3 2027 (6:30-8:30 pm confirmed for Nov 18 only). Community tournament Nov 1 2026 (past; $45 with lunch).

name: J KC (Jewish Community Center of Greater Kansas City) Mahjong
description: Adult 55+ Mahjong lessons at the J in Overland Park. Evidence is a search snippet and KCUR; the J's own page was not readable (403).
schedule: Wednesdays 12:30 in the Skills Lab (Adult 55+ program); fee about $20 per search snippet (unconfirmed whether per class).

name: Chicken N Pickle Overland Park American Mahjong 101 & 102
description: Two-part beginner series taught by Katie Duffy of KC Mahjong Club at Chicken N Pickle Overland Park. Event page URL (american-mahjong-at-cnp-overland-park-2) returned 404 when opened, so wording and dates are unconfirmed.
schedule: Two-part series (101 then 102); about $125 per search snippet (unconfirmed). No dates verified.

name: Johnson County Community College Mah Jongg Courses
description: JCCC Continuing Education Mah Jongg 101 and intermediate courses at the Regnier Center. Own course pages: "deepen your understanding of National Mahjongg League (NMJL) rules" and "bring a 2026 National Mah Jongg League card". Course pages show past or year-less dates only.
schedule: Courses seen: Mah Jongg 101 (Shari Albright, 3 hrs, $80); Mah Jongg: Building a Winning Hand (Aimee Patton, 3 evenings 6-8 pm, $80). A search snippet mentioned Building a Winning Hand 12/15-12/17/2026 but the page could not be opened to confirm.
